title: Turn a defect into traceable feedback and a regression case
steps: Capture FeedbackEvent with explicit expected behavior and cause status.
Trace backward through inputs to the smallest suspected stage.
Invalidate typed descendants; retain failed and corrected attempts.
Export frozen evidence/expectations to the existing evaluator owner; record actual quality/cost/time or null.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
